modules.title: Introduction to Life of Prophet Muhammad in Makkah
modules.html:
The birth and early life of the Prophet, the call to prophethood, and the opposition faced in Makkah. This section covers introduction to life of prophet muhammad in makkah.

Key points

  • The Qur'an was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (SAW) over a period of approximately _____ years. — 23.
  • The 'Sunnah' refers to the _____ of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW). — sayings, actions, and approvals.
  • The collection of sayings and deeds of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) is called _____. — Hadith.
  • The Prophet Muhammad (SAW) belonged to the tribe of _____. — Quraysh.
  • The first revelation was received by Prophet Muhammad (SAW) in: — Cave Hira.

Worked examples

Q: The Qur'an was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (SAW) over a period of approximately _____ years.
A: 23 — The revelation began when the Prophet was 40 and ended shortly before his death at 63, totaling 23 years (13 in Makkah and 10 in Madinah).

Q: The 'Sunnah' refers to the _____ of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW).
A: sayings, actions, and approvals — Sunnah encompasses everything the Prophet said (Qawl), did (Fi'l), or tacitly approved (Taqrir).

quiz.q: The Qur'an was revealed to Prophet Muhammad (SAW) over a period of approximately _____ years.
quiz.solution: The revelation began when the Prophet was 40 and ended shortly before his death at 63, totaling 23 years (13 in Makkah and 10 in Madinah).

quiz.q: The 'Sunnah' refers to the _____ of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW).
quiz.solution: Sunnah encompasses everything the Prophet said (Qawl), did (Fi'l), or tacitly approved (Taqrir).

quiz.q: The collection of sayings and deeds of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) is called _____.
quiz.solution: Hadith is the record of the Sunnah.

quiz.q: The Prophet Muhammad (SAW) belonged to the tribe of _____.
quiz.solution: He was from the Banu Hashim clan of the Quraysh tribe in Makkah.
